query: Compare our Enterprise SLA to Acme Enterprise and explain the main gap in uptime commitment and service credits.
final_answer:
Our Enterprise SLA vs Acme Enterprise comparison:
- Our Enterprise: 99.9% uptime guarantee with 50% service credit for breaches
- Acme Enterprise: 99.95% uptime guarantee with 30% service credit
- Main gap: Acme offers higher uptime at 99.95% vs our 99.9%
